steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have been changed (or the scheduled service was done).
Put the key in the ignition and turn it to position I without starting the engine.
Press and hold the trip meter reset button on the instrument cluster.
Keep holding it and turn the key to position II.
When the amber information light starts to flash, let go of the button. A short chime confirms the service message has been cleared.
oil.note: Check that all due maintenance has really been done before clearing the reminder.
